tasks.label: Build & Deploy (orahdex.com)
tasks.command: cd ~/OrahDEX-app && export NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 && pnpm --filter @workspace/bsv-dex build && pkill -f 'dist/index.mjs'; sleep 2; cd artifacts/api-server && nohup node --env-file=.env --enable-source-maps --max-old-space-size=3072 --expose-gc ./dist/index.mjs > ~/api-server.log 2>&1 & sleep 8; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'DEPLOYED - domain: %{http_code}\n' https://orahdex.com

tasks.label: Health Check
tasks.command: curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/health | head -c 100; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'domain: %{http_code}\n' https://orahdex.com
